name: Mamiya Yumiko
source:
Penny Nichols is a part-time assistant at Global Studios in charge of props. She is obsessed with The Steel Samurai: Warrior of Neo Olde Tokyo, and collects Steel Samurai trading cards. Nichols could be considered to be amongst the most "normal" of the individuals Wright met during his career. Her only real personality quirk is her love of the Samurai franchise. 

[Based on her [URL=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Ace_Attorney_Wiki]Ace Attorney Wiki[/URL] page.]
